t: Norfolk House was the London home of the Howard family, the Dukes of Norfolk, and the name has been given to more than one building. The first stood opposite Lambeth Palace, in large gardens and orchards, on ground now occupied by the Novotel London Waterloo. Several people are linked to a house of this name. King George III was born here, and so was his sister Princess Elizabeth. Two Dukes of Norfolk, Henry the seventh and Bernard the twelfth, died here. Edward Howard, later Baron Howard of Glossop, was also born here.
